newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Minsa sees $70 mln from share offerings.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Minsa sees $70 mln from share offerings.

text.p: Mexican corn flour maker Grupo Minsa S.A. expects to raise $70 million from its primary and secondary share offerings due in the third week of March, a company director said on Monday.

"It's a simultaneous mixed public offering," a company official who asked not to be identified told Reuters. "The type of stock in the primary offering is the C series, without a vote, representing 29,114,000 shares. That accounts for 82 percent of the offering."
The secondary offering is for 6,386,000 shares. Both offerings will be placed in Mexico and abroad at the same time.
